rv.q: "Jane: Abortion and the Underground" is an impressive piece of theatre that I highly recommend for everyone.
The story is well-paced and gripping, moving between the interviews and fictionalized scenes.
Playwright Paula Kamen crafts a compelling story that is suspenseful even knowing how it turns out.
Whether you are pro- or anti-choice, this show is important to see.

cn.t: Critics praise this timely docudrama about Chicago's underground abortion network as compelling and thoughtfully staged, with strong ensemble work bringing historical firsthand accounts to urgent, socially significant life.
